backup.title: Backups
backup.intro: Once a day while Lumen is open, the whole vault is copied to another drive or folder. Kept: 7 daily, 4 weekly and 6 monthly backups. Version history stays on this disk; this protects against losing the disk.
backup.mode.plain: plain copy (.tar, any tool opens it)
backup.mode.age: encrypted (.tar.age, opens with your backup key)
backup.choose.plain: Back up to a folder or drive…
backup.choose.age: Back up encrypted to a folder or drive…
backup.key.title: Your backup key
backup.key.note: Save this key somewhere safe, away from this device. Without it nobody can open an encrypted backup, you included.
backup.restoreAll: Restore everything to a new folder…
backup.restorePath: Path to restore (a file or a folder)
backup.restoredKept: Restored {n} files; {m} were already there, so they were restored next to them.
backup.insideVault: That folder is the vault or inside it. Choose a folder on another drive, outside the vault.
backup.reconnect: Allow access to the backup folder again: open Backups and press Back up now.
